title: Report Builder
content: Build report builder interface. Metrics selection: choose which metrics to include. Dimensions: select grouping dimensions. Filters: add filters to narrow data. variants.simple: Create interface for building custom reports.
variants.detailed: Build report builder interface. Metrics selection: choose which metrics to include. Dimensions: select grouping dimensions. Filters: add filters to narrow data. Visualization: choose chart type. Layout: arrange components. Preview: see report preview. Save: save report configuration. Schedule: set up recurring reports. Export: download in various formats.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive report builder for custom analytics. Report configuration: metric selector (multi-select from available metrics), dimension selector (group by fields), filter builder (add conditions). Drag and drop: drag metrics/dimensions into report areas, remove by dragging out or X button. Filter builder: add filter rows, select field, operator (equals, contains, greater than), value input, AND/OR logic, nested conditions. Visualization options: chart type selector (table, line, bar, pie, etc.), chart-specific options (stacking, orientation). Layout builder: drag and drop widgets on canvas grid, resize widgets, multi-column layouts. Live preview: preview updates as configuration changes, loading indicator for queries. Query builder: optional SQL mode for advanced users, validate query syntax. Save report: name and description, save to personal or shared reports, folder organization. Report templates: start from templates, share report configs. Sharing: share report with team members, public link option. Schedule: set up recurring email delivery, frequency (daily, weekly, monthly), recipient list, delivery time. Export formats: PDF, CSV, Excel, PNG for charts. Parameters: date range selector on saved reports, user-input parameters. Favorites: mark frequently used reports. Recent reports: quick access to recently viewed. Permissions: control who can edit vs view reports. Versioning: track report configuration changes. Embedding: generate embed code for external use.
